notes: Two fixes in the editor. A vertical 4K project now exports at full 4K — the size limit was written for landscape footage, so tall videos were quietly shrunk to a third of their pixels on every export. And on a slideshow with crossfades, the end of the timeline is reachable again: the playhead used to stop short, so scrubbing, Next cut and right-click “Split here” on the last few clips acted on the wrong clip.
